A '''''Nu''-class attack shuttle''' was used to transport [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[mission to Taloraan]].
